title: foss-mcp reuse manifest
description: Records the reuse disposition for one evaluated upstream component: what it is, which of the mission's 8 dispositions applies, and why. The disposition enum is closed on purpose - an ad hoc ninth value would silently escape every downstream policy keyed to these 8.

component.description: Identifier of the evaluated upstream component or dependency.

disposition.description: One of the mission's 8 reuse dispositions. Closed enum.

evidence.description: Optional pointers to supporting evidence (file paths, URLs, commit SHAs).
